body:
A few small issues.

More generally, should we be representing these requirements in YAML when it is simple to do so?

## Pull request overview This PR simplifies parameter typing by removing conditional/ambiguous parameter schemas and making parameter schema types unconditional, shifting architecture-dependent constraints into `requirements` conditions. **Changes:** - Remove conditional parameter-schema selection (`schema_known?`, `possible_schemas`, `maximal_*`) and rely on a single unconditional schema plus `requirements`. - Update Z3 schema constraint handling for `allOf` to apply constraints from each subschema. - Convert several parameter YAMLs from conditional `schema.oneOf` forms to unconditional schemas with RV32-specific limits enforced via `requirements`. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 19 out of 22 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.
